entries.summary: Baseline of the kernel-owned capability catalog: 29 keys across six contexts, with SaaS, EDU, and Enterprise manifests, dependency edges, and configuration-flag bindings as they stand after the catalog moved into src/kernel/composition.
Enterprise client composition is now a real pack-owned deny-only surface with backend-owned frontend surface metadata
Declared the SaaS-only public marketing site; EDU and Enterprise deployments go straight to login.
Added the self-serve auth capability so SaaS composes email, Google, and public signup while enterprise and edu keep provider-only sign-in.
Enabled the configurable SaaS self-serve auth slice while keeping billing checkout deferred and EDU or Enterprise provider-only.
Added the limited EDU authentication surface with server-adapted Supabase recovery, staff GitHub linking, and lab session context.
